title: Onboard solace-30b v1.0: metadata, performance profiles, and changelog automation
author: Marina Alvarez
description: Add new model 'solace-30b' v1.0 to the model registry with full metadata, machine-specific performance profiles, and automated changelog/release-note generation. Motivation: product teams requested a high-quality, open-weight 30B with strong inference latency/cost tradeoffs; this PR standardizes metadata, provides perf profiles for A100-40GB, A10G, and quantized CPU paths, and wires the model entry into the changelog automation pipeline. Changes include: 1) model manifest: model_id=solace-30b, semantic_version=1.0.0, license and weights uri placeholders, owner=marina@redwood.ai, architectures supported=[fp16, int8-gguf], tokenizer=BPE, input/output schema. 2) perf profiles: per-device JSON profiles for common batch/seq combos (batch=1,4,8 sequence=128,512) with median latency, p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost_per_1k_tokens estimate, kv_cache_compatibility flags. 3) metadata/versioning: bump model manifest schema to v2, add provenance fields (commit sha, dataset snapshot id), add 'quality_checks' tag with evaluation score summary. 4) changelog automation: hook in model registry index to the changelog generator so releases are included in the automated release_notes draft; added mapping to release-notes-template and sample entry. 5) tests and perf runs: added lightweight perf harness run artifacts and CI smoke tests to validate loading and basic generation on CPU and CUDA test matrix. Checklist: - [x] manifest adheres to schema v2 - [x] perf profiles validated on A100/A10G and quantized CPU in perf-lab - [x] changelog entry auto-generated by pipeline on merge - [x] unit tests updated for manifest parsing - [x] Linear tickets linked: ENG-15920. Notes/limitations: weights URIs are placeholders pending private bucket release; quantized int8 profile is from internal quantization pipeline (int8-gguf) and marked experimental; p95 values measured on internal perf-lab and will be re-run during staged rollout. Migration considerations: no breaking schema changes for consumers; manifest v2 is backward-compatible with a deprecation path for v1. See release_notes field for the automated release note that will appear in the changelog.

review_comments: Ethan Park (review): Can you add the exact commit sha for the quantization pipeline used to produce the int8 weights? We need reproducibility for QA.
Marina Alvarez (author): Added provenance.commit_sha and provenance.dataset_snapshot in manifest; see updated manifest.json commit field.
Priya Nand (review): The p95 numbers look optimistic compared to earlier runs. Did you run with padding disabled? Please confirm comparison baseline.
Marina Alvarez (author): We measured p95 with dynamic batching disabled; added note in perf profile metadata and included raw perf artifact in perf-lab/artifacts. Will re-run with padding to compare.
Liam O'Connor (approver): Verified manifest parsing unit tests and perf smoke CI on A100 matrix. Approving once CI passes.
Ethan Park (request change): Please mark the cpu-int8 profile as experimental in the manifest and add an explicit fallback to fp16 in the runtime routing policy.
Marina Alvarez (author): Marked cpu-int8 experiment=true and added runtime routing fallback section to registry/index.json. Thanks for the review.
release_notes: Added solace-30b v1.0: new 30B open-weight model with curated performance profiles for GPU and experimental int8 CPU paths. Includes manifest schema v2 metadata and automated changelog entry generation. Note: weights URIs will be populated at release time; int8 CPU profile is experimental and marked as such.
